notes: Job Agent v3.0.1 beta adds optional Gmail review for replies to already-confirmed applications. Settings > Gmail allows manual Google Desktop OAuth authorization for the gmail.readonly scope; you must supply your own Google Cloud Desktop OAuth JSON (not bundled with the app). Access/refresh tokens are stored in the local macOS Keychain. Applications > Проверить ответы в Gmail initiates a read-only search on demand (up to 40 recent messages from the last 90 days; headers and short snippets only). Suggestions are matched to saved submitted vacancies using unambiguous posting IDs or company and role terms; ambiguous messages are ignored. Review suggestions in a modal, open the original Gmail thread, and record recruiter stage manually. No automatic email sending, status edits, background scans, application submissions, or CV upload to Google. Settings and existing submission history remain compatible. PR #21 GitHub offline regression CI passed all 97 tests; native macOS packaging and real Google authorization require separate verification.
